links.outcome: Inflated mortality prediction performance from ICD code label leakage; prevalence in literature
links.effect: ICD-only models reached AUROC 0.971-0.976 for in-hospital mortality; 37 of 92 (40.2%) MIMIC same-admission studies used ICD codes as features.
links.quote: The literature review found that 37 of 92 studies (40.2%) using MIMIC to predict same-admission outcomes included ICD codes as features, even though both MIMIC publications and documentation clearly state that ICD codes are derived after discharge.

unlisted_practices: Exclude features not available at prediction time (e.g., post-discharge ICD codes) to avoid label leakage in model development

screen.reason: The study empirically demonstrates the impact of label leakage (using post-discharge ICD diagnostic codes as predictive features for same-admission clinical outcomes) and reviews the prevalence of this flawed practice across literature, highlighting safety and validity considerations for AI model validation.

primary.practice: data leakage prevention / feature timing auditing
